A beautiful, peaceful tribute to generations of loved ones

## Family Owned Since 1945

Ridgeview Memorial Park is the flagship perpetual care cemetery of Turrentine-Jackson-Morrow, the premier funeral care provider in North Texas. With professionally designed and maintained grounds, a wide array of burial options and services to fit every need, Ridgeview Memorial Park is committed to being the choice of families for generations to come.

results.text:
McKinney, Allen & Plano, Texas | Turrentine Jackson Morrow

Our largest location is conveniently located on Highway 75, easily accessible to McKinney, Allen, Plano, and most communities throughout North Texas. With ample parking and easy entry, this beautiful facility includes a peaceful chapel that seats 275, generous visitation rooms for friends and family to gather, an on-site flower shop and gift shop, and a coffee shop proudly serving Starbucks coffee. We believe you’ll find our facility to be unlike any you’ve ever experienced.

Also located at this site are Ridgeview Memorial Park and our on-site crematory that serves all our North Texas locations. We encourage you to schedule a tour if you would like to learn more about our facility. Simply contact us and we will arrange a convenient time for you.

For driving directions, please note: Northbound Exit 38A on Central Expressway (Highway 75) is temporarily CLOSED due to highway construction. Northbound Central Expressway traffic should take northbound Exit 37 - Stacy Road - and follow the highway service road north approximately 1.8 miles to the Ridgeview Drive overpass.

Southbound Exit 38A - Ridgeview Drive is open
